# Scena Growth

> Make your brand known, and make it sell. Scena Growth is your marketing and sales team between France and the UAE, without opening a subsidiary, for premium perfume, beauty, food and lifestyle brands, in both directions: French brands aiming for Dubai and Abu Dhabi, Gulf houses aiming for Paris and France.

Scena Growth SAS (SIREN 130 123 938), Paris · Dubai · Abu Dhabi. English site: https://www.scenagrowth.com. French site: https://www.scenagrowth.fr.

## What Scena does
- Two jobs, one team. Make it known: strategy and positioning, marketing and communication, adapting the brand to the market, content and creators, press relations, events and pop-ups. Make it sell: channels and points of sale, buyer meetings, sales follow-up, orders, restocks, monthly steering.
- An agency makes noise, an agent opens doors: Scena does both.
- Start from the shelf, not the factory: price, partners and how to become known are decided from the end customer and the point of sale.
- No stock purchase: the brand keeps its price, its stock and its registrations. Scena Distribution is being set up: Scena can become a brand's official importer without buying its stock; the stock sits with a logistics partner.
- Nothing hidden: any relationship with a third party is disclosed to the brand and submitted for its approval.
- A commitment to the work done, measured every month (contacts, meetings, orders, restocks), never a promise of volume or listings.
- No public prices: pricing comes after Scena's presentation, with a proposal built for the brand.

## The journey
- [Diagnostic](https://www.scenagrowth.com/market-access#mission-1): two weeks to decide (launch, adjust or wait), starting from the shelf and the end customer. Ends with a written decision and its reasons.
- [90-day Launch](https://www.scenagrowth.com/market-access#mission-2): ninety days to set up what is needed to sell on the ground, make the brand known and go after the first orders. Review on day 90.
- [Sales representation](https://www.scenagrowth.com/market-access#mission-3): your team on the ground, month after month: it sells the brand and keeps it visible, with no subsidiary to open. Monthly dashboard.
- What happens next: a 20 to 30-minute call (your ambitions, your products, your markets), then Scena's presentation, then a proposal built for your brand, then pricing with that proposal.

## Modules
- [90-day trade-show follow-up](https://www.scenagrowth.com/france-to-uae) (France → UAE): working the contacts from a Dubai trade fair for 90 days: follow-ups, buyer meetings, follow-through up to the first orders.
- [Paris Launch](https://www.scenagrowth.com/uae-to-france) (UAE → France): enter France compliant and selling: regulation with specialists, the first points of sale, the Paris launch, one team.
- [SCENA Real Estate](https://www.scenagrowth.com/real-estate), a separate service: bilingual French-English property visualizations and films from supplied plans, for developers, agents and architects. Not a real-estate agency and not a premises search. The SCENA Residence example is a fictional creative concept. French: https://www.scenagrowth.fr/real-estate

## Directions
- [France → UAE](https://www.scenagrowth.com/france-to-uae): premium French brands entering Dubai and Abu Dhabi without a subsidiary: diagnostic, product registration with Dubai Municipality (Montaji), official importer or distributor, launch, sales. French: https://www.scenagrowth.fr/france-to-uae
- [UAE → France](https://www.scenagrowth.com/uae-to-france): Gulf perfume and beauty houses entering France: EU Responsible Person, CPNP notification, French labelling and fragrance allergens, EORI and import VAT, the Paris launch, independent perfumeries and concept stores. French: https://www.scenagrowth.fr/uae-to-france

Free PDF sent by email. French: https://www.scenagrowth.fr/guide-prix-parfum-dubai

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What does Scena Growth do?
  A: It makes premium brands known and makes them sell between France and the UAE, in both directions: your marketing and sales team on the ground, without opening a subsidiary.
- Q: Does Scena hold stock?
  A: No. Scena Distribution is being set up. Scena can become a brand's official importer without buying its stock: the brand keeps ownership of its stock, its price and its registrations, and the stock sits with a logistics partner.
- Q: How much does it cost?
  A: Pricing comes after Scena's presentation, with a proposal built for the brand.
- Q: Does Scena guarantee sales, listings or funding?
  A: No. Scena commits to the work done, measured every month, never to a volume, a listing or funding.
- Q: Does a brand need a company in the UAE or in France?
  A: Not to start with. Import can go through an official importer and sales through distributors and points of sale; a local structure is decided when results justify it. Legal points are to be checked with an adviser.
